questions.question: What does the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirtieth Amendment) Bill, 2025 propose?

options.text: Automatic resignation after an election defeat
Automatic removal of ministers after 30 days of detention
Dismissal of ministers after a conviction
Suspension of ministers after any criminal charge

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Automatic removal of ministers after 30 days of detention**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Amit Shah Introduces Bill for Automatic Removal of Ministers After 30 Days of Detention.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
On **20 August 2025**, **Amit Shah**, **Union Home Minister**, introduced the **Constitution (One Hundred and Thirtieth Amendment) Bill, 2025** in **Lok Sabha**.

 
 
• 
 
The Bill allows the **automatic removal** of the **Prime Minister**, **Chief Ministers**, and other **ministers** if detained for **30 consecutive days** on charges carrying a minimum **five-year sentence**, even without conviction.

 
 
• 
 
The Bill proposes **constitutional amendments** in:

 
 
• 
 
**Article 75** (Union Council of Ministers): Ministers must resign by the **31st day of detention** or be automatically removed.

 
 
• 
 
**Article 164** (State Council of Ministers): Applies similar rules for **Chief Ministers** at the state level.

 
 
• 
 
**Article 239AA** (Delhi’s Executive): Applies the same rules to **Delhi’s ministers** and **Chief Minister**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Implementation Mechanism**: A detained minister must either be **removed officially** or automatically cease office after **30 days** in custody. If **bail** isn't secured within **30 days**, the person will be removed automatically on the **31st day**.

 
 
• 
 
The Bill has been referred to a **Joint Parliamentary Committee** for further review.

 
 
• 
 
**Objectives**: Upholds **constitutional morality**, ensures **clean governance**, and aligns with the suspension of **civil servants** upon arrest.

 
 
• 
 
**Criticism**: Concerns about political misuse, selective arrests, and undermining constitutional principles like **presumption of innocence**, **separation of powers**, and **federalism**.

 
 
• 
 
**Support**: Some view it as a necessary reform to ensure **accountability** and address cases of leaders continuing in office despite ongoing criminal proceedings.

questions.question: Which new Harappan site has been discovered in Rajasthan?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ratadiya Ri Dheri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 4500-year-old Harappan civilisation remains discovered near Pak border in Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **Harappan site** has been discovered at **Ratadiya Ri Dheri** in **Jaisalmer**, Rajasthan.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first known Indus Valley settlement** in the **Jaisalmer district**.

 
 
• 
 
The site is located **17 km northwest** of **Sadewala** in **Pakistan**, where Harappan traces were earlier found.

 
 
• 
 
This discovery **bridges the archaeological gap** between **northern Rajasthan** and **Gujarat**.

 
 
• 
 
Previously, **Pilibanga** was the most prominent Harappan site in Rajasthan.

 
 
• 
 
Pilibanga was studied by **Luigi Pio Tessitori**, an Italian Indologist, and excavated in the **1960s**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Harappan civilization** is among the **oldest civilizations**, along with **Egypt** and **Mesopotamia**.

 
 
• 
 
It developed along the **Indus River**, hence also known as the **Indus Valley Civilization**.

 
 
• 
 
It is classified as a **Bronze Age civilization**, known for using **copper-based alloys**.

questions.question: Cloudburst Over Kheer Ganga River Triggers Flash Floods in Uttarkashi. Which village was affected by the flash floods?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **cloudburst** occurred over the **Kheer Ganga River**, a **tributary of the Alaknanda River**.

 
 
• 
 
It triggered **flash floods** in **Dharali**, a **high-altitude village** in **Uttarkashi district**, **Uttarakhand**.

 
 
• 
 
A **cloudburst** is defined as **extremely intense rainfall** exceeding **100 mm in one hour** over a small area (~10 km²).

 
 
• 
 
These events are common in **mountainous regions**, especially the **Himalayas**.

 
 
• 
 
Causes include **steep terrain**, **orographic lift**, and **localized convection**.

questions.question: India has nominated the ancient Buddhist site Sarnath for UNESCO World Heritage Status 2025. In which Indian state is Sarnath located?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Nominates Sarnath for UNESCO World Heritage Status 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India submitted a dossier for **“Ancient Buddhist Site, Sarnath”** to **UNESCO** for the **2025–26 nomination cycle**.

 
 
• 
 
**Sarnath**, located near **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh**, is where **Gautama Buddha** delivered his **first sermon** – the **Dhammachakkappavattana Sutta**.

 
 
• 
 
Marks the **beginning of the Buddhist Sangha** (monastic community).

 
 
• 
 
One of the **four most sacred Buddhist pilgrimage sites**, along with **Bodh Gaya**, **Lumbini**, and **Kushinagar**.

 
 
• 
 
Was a major **centre of Buddhist learning** and **cultural exchange** on ancient pilgrimage routes.

 
 
• 
 
Reflects **Mauryan**, **Kushan**, and **Gupta architectural styles**.

 
 
• 
 
**Dhamek Stupa** (built in 500 CE) commemorates Buddha’s first sermon.

 
 
• 
 
**Ashokan Pillar**, originally topped with the **Lion Capital** (now India’s **national emblem**).

 
 
• 
 
**Chaukhandi Stupa** marks the site where Buddha met his **first disciples**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mulagandha Kuti Vihar**, a modern temple with **Buddha frescoes**, built by the **Mahabodhi Society**.

 
 
• 
 
**Sarnath Archaeological Museum** preserves key artefacts including the **original Lion Capital**.

questions.question: Which institute’s researchers have developed a nanotechnology-based biosensor capable of detecting Parkinson’s Disease before symptoms appear?

options.text: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS), Bengaluru
Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Researchers at the Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali, have developed a nanotechnology-based biosensor to detect Parkinson’s Disease even before symptoms appear.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The biosensor uses gold nanoclusters (AuNCs), ultrasmall glowing particles only a few nanometres wide.**
 
• **Proline-coated clusters bind to normal α-synuclein protein, which is harmless.**
 
• **Histidine-coated clusters bind to aggregated amyloid α-synuclein, which causes Parkinson’s disease.**
 
• **This allows the sensor to distinguish between healthy and harmful protein states, enabling early diagnosis of Parkinson’s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Parkinson’s Disease__

 __
 
• A progressive neurodegenerative disorder affecting movement and motor control.
 
• Caused by the loss of dopamine-producing neurons in the brain.
 
• Linked to abnormal misfolding and aggregation of α-synuclein protein.
 
• Symptoms include tremors, rigidity, slowness of movement, and postural instability.
 
 
 
• Gold Nanoclusters (AuNCs)__
 __
 
• Ultrasmall nanoparticles with glowing properties, only a few nanometres wide.
 
• Modified with amino acids for selective binding to proteins.
 
 
 
• Significance__
 
 
• Provides early detection before motor symptoms manifest.
 
• Could revolutionise Parkinson’s screening and timely intervention strategies.

questions.question: What is the Mela Patt festival in Jammu and Kashmir dedicated to?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Vasuki Nag.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Mela Patt festival in Jammu and Kashmir is dedicated to Lord Vasuki Nag, the presiding deity of Bhaderwah Valley.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The festival celebrates Lord Vasuki Nag and marks the historic meeting between Mughal Emperor Akbar and King Nag Pal.**
 
• **Mela Patt has been celebrated since the 16th century and is observed annually on Nag Panchami.**
 
• **The festival promotes communal harmony and unity, with the participation of people from all religions and backgrounds.**
 
• **The Dikko Dance performed during the festival symbolizes peace and pride for the local community.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Nag Panchami__

 __
 
• A Hindu festival dedicated to the worship of snakes, observed on the fifth day of the lunar month of Shravan.
 
 
 
• Dikko Dance__
 
 
• A traditional folk dance performed during Mela Patt, symbolizing communal harmony and unity.
